name: piano-tutor
description: A Windows desktop piano tutor for a Yamaha CK88 over USB MIDI.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "main,preload,vite,electron" -c "yellow,magenta,cyan,green" "node esbuild.main.mjs --watch" "node esbuild.preload.mjs --watch" "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 file:dist/main/index.cjs file:dist/preload/index.cjs && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.core.json
scripts.gate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && node scripts/check-pins.mjs && node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs && npm run test:e2e
